posts.title: petgraph-wasm: Fast Graph Algorithms for the Browser
posts.description: A WebAssembly port of Rust's petgraph for JavaScript and TypeScript. It runs graph algorithms like shortest paths, centrality, max flow, and cliques on thousands of nodes in under a millisecond, fast enough to use inside an interactive UI.

posts.title: Directed Random Walk Betweenness Centrality
posts.description: A random-walk betweenness centrality implementation that extends it to directed graphs using absorbing Markov chains

posts.title: Epochron Multi-Stopwatch
posts.description: Most stopwatches assume one runner and one clock. Epochron is built for coaches and timers tracking multiple people at once. It supports group stopwatches for relays, heats, or ranked comparisons, and get live split predictions mid-race instead of doing the math yourself.
